newsitem.title: GERMANY: Flood-hit E.German farmers receive EU assistance.
newsitem.headline: Flood-hit E.German farmers receive EU assistance.

text.p: Farmers in eastern German flood regions have been given permission to apply for the early pay-out of farm support monies from Brussels, the Bonn farm ministry said on Monday.

Farmers may be paid compensation payments in September for grains and protein crops under EU farm reform rules, due not before October 16, it said in a weekly circular. Up to 30 million marks may be paid out early.
Brussels also agreed to treat as force majeure the slaughter of suckler cows in the flooded regions, where grazing land was flooded and animals had to be evacuated.
This means cow premiums will not be lost even if the animals had been kept on the affected farms for less than six months.
Three weeks of floods in July and August hit 30 farms with 12,000 hectares of fertile land.
